service.description: AgreementList's agreements (design §7 AgreementFind): the customer agreements of the caller's organizations (or the one named), by state (open: draft or active, the default; draft; active; expiring: active and ending within 30 days; ended: expired, closed or cancelled; templates; all; templates only under templates), customer, type, text (name or id), a date range they are in effect in, or an order (orderId: the agreements whose prices its lines took, of a quote or order the caller sees), paged. Refuses a caller who reads no Sales (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a state not listed (STATE_INVALID) and an order the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

AgreementDetail's agreement as the caller may see it, else agreementFound false: its header (type, name, text, organization, customer, currency, dates, status, revision, the template it came from, the agreement it renews and its renewal), what activation still needs (activationIssues: each code and message), its parties with their side and role, its terms, its items with the negotiated price in effect, its documents (AgreementContent), the quote and order lines priced from it that the caller sees, the history of its audited fields, the term types, and what the caller may do (edit, activate, end, renew, start an agreement from a template).

The agreement's print as it is now (design-sales §7 AgreementDetail, §16 Agreement; html-print and PDF; Sales P20 review): its parties, items with their negotiated prices, terms and text from the agreement's own records, marked a draft until it is active. For one who reads the agreement (a Sales reader of its organization); another organization's, a purchase agreement and a missing one RECORD_UNAVAILABLE alike. No cost, margin or linked orders.

NewAgreement (design §7): a draft customer agreement at revision 1 of a selling organization of the caller's scope (else the default one) with a customer that is an account of it or shared, a sales (AgrSales, the default) or product (AgrProduct) agreement, its name, currency (else the template's, else the organization's), dates and text; or a template (isTemplate, no customer needed). With templateAgreementId, a template of the same organization, its items with their prices, its terms and its text are copied, the prices the new customer's. Refuses a caller without SALES_AGREEMENT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a customer that is not such an account (CUSTOMER_INVALID), a template that is not one of the organization's (TEMPLATE_INVALID), another type (TYPE_INVALID), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), an unknown currency (CURRENCY_INVALID) and dates out of order (DATE_INVALID).

AgreementHeader (design §7): a draft's name, text, customer (an account of the organization; its prices follow), currency and dates; an active agreement's name, text and a later through date. The revision is counted once, with the change reason in the audit log. Refuses a caller without SALES_AGREEMENT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an agreement the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an expired, closed or cancelled one (AGREEMENT_CLOSED), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), an active agreement's customer, currency or start (CUSTOMER_LOCKED, CURRENCY_LOCKED, DATE_LOCKED), a through date already past or dates out of order (DATE_INVALID), no name (NAME_REQUIRED) and a customer that is not an account of the organization (CUSTOMER_INVALID).

AgreementParties (design §7): a party added to a draft or active agreement in an agreement role (AgreementSigner by default), or removed (remove): the organization, the customer, a current contact of the customer or a person working for the organization. Refuses a caller without SALES_AGREEMENT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an agreement the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an ended one (AGREEMENT_CLOSED), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), a role that is not an agreement role (ROLE_INVALID), any other party (PARTY_INVALID), a party not on it (PARTY_UNAVAILABLE) and the removal of an active agreement's last signer of the customer's (PARTIES_REQUIRED).

AgreementTerms (design §7): a settlement or other term (a TermType term type, a settlement term, its text and value, an item it applies to, its dates) added, changed or removed (remove). A draft's term changes in place and is removed; an active agreement's is ended now and its change started as a new term, so the earlier wording stays readable. Refuses a caller without SALES_AGREEMENT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an agreement the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an ended one (AGREEMENT_CLOSED), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), a term not on it (TERM_UNAVAILABLE), no or another type or an unknown settlement term (TERM_TYPE_INVALID), an item not on it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE) and a negative value (AMOUNT_INVALID).

AgreementItems and AgreementPrices (design §7): an item added, changed or removed (remove): a pricing item (AitPricing, the default) for a product of the organization's or the shared catalogue with its negotiated price and minimum quantity (a ProductPrice row naming the agreement and item, the organization the vendor and the customer the customer, in the agreement's currency), or a section or exhibit of text; its quantity, unit, text and dates, inside the agreement's. A draft's item and price change in place and a removed one goes; an active agreement's price change ends the price in effect now and starts the next, and a removed item is ended, so an order priced earlier keeps its price and the price as of a time stays readable. Refuses a caller without SALES_AGREEMENT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an agreement the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an ended one (AGREEMENT_CLOSED), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), an item not on it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE), another item type (ITEM_TYPE_INVALID), a pricing item or price without a product (PRODUCT_REQUIRED), another organization's product (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE), an active item's product change (PRODUCT_LOCKED), a new pricing price missing (PRICE_REQUIRED), a negative amount (AMOUNT_INVALID), dates out of order or outside the agreement's (DATE_INVALID) and a product added to an active agreement that another active agreement with the customer prices in its dates (AGREEMENT_OVERLAP).

ActivateAgreement (design §7): a draft set Active from its start (the date given, else its own, else now), once it has its customer and a signer of the customer's (the customer or a current contact), its dates in order and not ended, its acceptance evidence (a signed agreement document, AgreementContent of type AcntDocument, or the evidence given here, kept as one), and its items, prices or terms (each pricing item priced, every price row in its currency and of its own parties). A renewal ends the agreement it renews at its start (closed when that is now). Refuses a caller without SALES_AGREEMENT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an agreement the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), a template (TEMPLATE_NO_ACTIVATE), one that is not a draft (STATUS_INVALID), and by its first missing need PARTIES_REQUIRED, DATE_INVALID, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, TERMS_REQUIRED, PRICE_REQUIRED, PRICE_INVALID or AGREEMENT_OVERLAP (another active agreement with the customer in these dates prices one of its products; a renewal's predecessor is not counted), naming each.

EndAgreement (design §7), with its reason in the audit log: a draft cancelled; an active agreement closed now, or ended at a later end date (it stays active until then and the job then expires it); an expired one closed. Its prices stop for a new quote from its end; its orders, their prices and their subscriptions are not changed. Refuses a caller without SALES_AGREEMENT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an agreement the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), an end before a later start (DATE_INVALID) and a closed or cancelled one (AGREEMENT_CLOSED).

Renewal as a dated successor (design §7): a draft copy of an active or expired agreement (its parties, its items with their prices in effect, its terms in effect and its text), from the date given, else its end (or now when that has passed), for the same length when it had one, linked to it through AgreementAssoc (AatRenewal); its activation ends the predecessor. Refuses a caller without SALES_AGREEMENT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an agreement the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a template (TEMPLATE_NO_ACTIVATE), a draft, closed or cancelled one (STATUS_INVALID), one renewed already by an agreement not cancelled (SUCCESSOR_EXISTS), a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED; the predecessor's revision is counted) and dates out of order (DATE_INVALID).

The daily job (expire_SalesAgreements, beside Purchasing's expire_PurchaseAgreements): each active customer agreement (AgrSales, AgrProduct) past its through date set Expired, each in its own transaction (one that fails is logged and the others go on). Its orders stay; the price resolver stops its prices at the date already.
